frontmatter.name: replica
frontmatter.description: Rebuild a web page, section, component or interaction from a reference (a live URL, a local HTML file, a screenshot or design export, or a screen recording or GIF) inside the user's own codebase. Then measure the rebuild against the reference (element boxes, computed styles, pixels, motion timing and easing) and iterate until a numeric Replica Score passes. Use when the user wants to clone, replicate, recreate, copy, port or match a site, landing page, hero, navbar, pricing table, card, modal, footer,
